title: sium amomum
intro: Sium amomum, commonly known as water celery or earth celery, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Apiaceae. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
